description: Manage Alibaba Cloud PolarDB-X instance lifecycle and routine operations via the Aliyun CLI. Use when the user asks to create, delete, restart, scale, modify, monitor, or inspect PolarDB-X instances. Triggers: "polardb-x", "polardbx", "create polardb-x", "delete polardb-x", "restart polardb-x", "scale polardb-x", "upgrade polardb-x", "describe polardb-x", "polardb-x instance", "polardb-x parameters", "polardb-x slow log", "polardb-x performance", "polardb-x binlog"
